segments.sn48.44:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbakoṭṭhake.
segments.sn48.44:1.3: Tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn48.44:1.5: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosāna”nti?
segments.sn48.44:2.1: “Na khvāhaṃ ettha, bhante, bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi –
segments.sn48.44:2.2: saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.sn48.44:2.3: Yesañhetaṃ, bhante, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ [apassitaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.), aphusitaṃ (pī.)] paññāya, te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn48.44:2.4: saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.sn48.44:2.5: Yesañca kho etaṃ, bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā –
segments.sn48.44:2.6: saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.sn48.44:2.7: Mayhañca kho etaṃ, bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya.
segments.sn48.44:2.8: Nikkaṅkhavāhaṃ tattha nibbicikiccho saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosāna”nti.
segments.sn48.44:3.2: Yesañhetaṃ, sāriputta, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya, te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn48.44:3.3: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
segments.sn48.44:3.4: Yesañca kho etaṃ, sāriputta, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā –
segments.sn48.44:3.5: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosāna”nti.

lines: Sādhu sādhūti therassa byākaraṇaṃ pasaṃsanto sādhukāraṃ deti. 5.
